decision.explanation: Uhldingen-Mühlhofen is described as a member of both Kommunale Informationsverarbeitung Reutlingen-Ulm (KIRU) in D1S10 and the SGCNZ Young Shakespeare Company in D2S2. Both claims are explicitly stated in their respective documents and do not contradict each other, as they refer to distinct memberships—one technological and one cultural. There is no evidence of conflicting interpretations or invalidation of either claim.
